preconditions.description: The input s must be a string.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abc' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s contains only the characters 'a', 'b', and 'c'.

postconditions.description: The output string has the same length as the input string.

postconditions.expression: all((return_value[i] == 'b' if s[i] == 'a' else ('a' if s[i] == 'b' else s[i])) == return_value[i] for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: For every position i, if the input character is 'a', the output is 'b'; if the input is 'b', the output is 'a'; if the input is 'c', the output remains 'c'.
